svg.title: Acute pyelonephritis MAT
svg.desc: One-hop context-object mat for acute pyelonephritis with fixed card zones and wire-free relationship containers.
svg.text: Pyelonephritis in its acute phase: edema and tubular obstruction that produce the imaging manifestations below. A subtype rather than an acuity element
because acute and chronic disease manifest differently (subtype-over-attribute rule, 2026-08-25 exchange).

g.text: occasional · note: assumes 07 Q2 answered yes: the causal pair takes typicality
note: obstruction predisposes; an obstructed infected system is pyonephrosis, not modeled here
